head: 2433a8ce570f34f5ad3dbf23f3d7367267aad461
title: Integrate Rust runtime and review repairs for release/3.2
body:
This PR integrates the Rust runtime and partitions the daemon, adapters, Protect, encrypted store, CLI, tests and dashboard around their authority and persistence boundaries. Hooks preserve typed approval bindings and durable native receipts. The current repair also fixes demonstrated macOS resident-response failures and Windows storage connections that incorrectly excluded one another.

Current source: [`2433a8ce570f34f5ad3dbf23f3d7367267aad461`](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/commit/2433a8ce570f34f5ad3dbf23f3d7367267aad461), tree `b0a1de665e3e0ea5da1252ad15fdf25716738d32`. All 43 files in this repair were verified against eight component manifests and their published Git blobs; the local checkout matches the published tree.

- Rust distinguishes a noncommand review after its actual extractor confirms command absence. Its receipt identity commits to that scope. Python binds the review to the selected enforcing ACK, request and policy digests, runtime identity and workspace. Command reviews retain their existing domain. Normal and Codex delivery forward their selected ACK.
- Migration 29 writes the scope marker atomically in a sidecar table, preserving the original receipt-table shape for prior readers. Current readback validates the joined marker and rejects missing binding evidence.
- Connect, authentication and partial I/O share the original monotonic deadline. On macOS Unix sockets, only a timeout-setter EINVAL plus an independently observed same-socket hangup permits a nonblocking read of buffered response bytes. Request/phase deadlines, response binding and digest checks, and fatal no-replay behavior remain intact.
- Windows storage admission uses the existing nonblocking Win32 shared/exclusive primitive. Ordinary connections can share the gate; recovery remains exclusive. The storage partition retains all 33 other methods, all facade defaults and all 54 initial SQL statements, including live facade patch points.
- Evidence collection preserves oracle identity through the actual privacy serializer and JSON round trip. The VFS observer retains a bounded loader descriptor for each permanently mapped extension image, preventing reuse of a descriptor alias for a different image. Hash/inode admission remains strict, and retained loader descriptors are distinguished from closed databases/VFS instances.
- Workspace observers attach before the real constructor starts publication. Fixed caller clocks distinguish constructor, service-start and acknowledgment boundaries. A failed expiry precondition retains finite publisher state only after the original rejection. Current fixture readers require an explicit attempt label, and the Ollama error branches are explicit.
- Secret fingerprints use constant-time byte comparison. Duplicate OAuth helpers are removed, compact receipt fixtures include the sidecar schema, and the decision fixture retains all 51,000 cases with its corrected source binding.

| Validation | Actual result and scope |
| --- | --- |
| Rust source | 297 workspace tests passed, six existing ignored; 17 selected resident-client controls passed locally. All-target/all-feature Clippy and rustfmt passed. The four new Mac-specific controls require hosted execution. |
| Python static checks | Production lint/format and all 37 changed Python files passed. Production basedpyright reports zero errors, warnings or notes. All changed code files in this 43-file repair are at most 500 physical lines. |
| Contract gates | Authority ownership, approval, semantic reachability, receipt persistence, capability cleanup, critical I/O ownership and privacy gates passed on the frozen published bytes. |
| Storage and observer controls | Storage cohort: 113 passed, one platform skip and one warning reproduced on exact original source. Both VFS/persistence module orders passed 47 controls. Workspace/expiry cohort: 96 passed. These populations overlap and are not summed. |
| Decision fixture | The complete 51,000-case decision-diff check passed on the combined source. The digest trailer is retained; it does not claim a GPG signature. |
| Secret scan | Fresh current-source Gitleaks scanned release base through this head: 1,341 commits and 68,722,466 bytes, with no leaks. Other current-source CI and installed results are still being collected. |
| Hosted platform validation | Both Mac jobs now explicitly run the resident-client regressions. The Windows wheel job explicitly runs storage concurrency controls. Full original Windows resident tests and installed default-auto/SLO runs remain separate gates. |

The [independent validation driver](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/tree/codex/pr2974-installed-validation-20260920-2433a8ce) is commit `c24e5687a74db8ae3850ab45b589d05d9b8755a4`, tree `85463cb6b0b3c416db9fc067972a049b9a200f66`. It binds this exact candidate/tree and untouched baseline `2e672d2d950c6ec471005ddba46e49bba16dc23b`, then runs four-platform paired smoke and Linux installed observer/persistence/workspace diagnostics. It retains actual Rust-produced receipt and resident controls, original gates and post-attempt-only resolver observation. Full qualification cannot begin until the required smoke gates pass.

Earlier failed cohorts remain evidence of their original source. On ed7313, the Linux normal soak completed 100,000 responses and 250,000 receipts with zero request errors, four transient health failures and 35.168% RSS growth: it passed that job's existing 50% soak ceiling, while the original 12% target remains unqualified for that window. Its separate default-auto run recorded SQLite busy attempts. Paired and observer runs retained comparator, readiness, mixed-delivery/resource and workspace failures. Both unchanged Mac baseline arms exceeded their original resolver-construction deadline. The standalone Windows first-review diagnostic passed, but differed from the original five-test run in cohort, imports and runtime artifact; it does not explain the earlier failure.

Policy freshness checks preserve securely captured bytes in the existing 250 ms background cycles and one-second full reconciliation. At 100 workspaces, the retained diagnostic measured 22.343 ms median / 47.551 ms p95 thread CPU per content check; three additional checks per second imply about 6.7% of one core at the median. This is not complete process-tree qualification. Service replacement proves two service instances in one Python process. VFS callbacks do not establish physical-device bytes or kernel fsync counts; short-exited-descendant CPU coverage remains incomplete.

The [immutable original PRD, TODO, Takeaway and ledger](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/tree/75bb8692b5eaaf6f2e138d5da20402b7d270a9bb/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/originals) retain all 144 tasks and 119 catalog entries, original statuses and dependencies. The exact earlier chat was unavailable; the preserved original documents were recovered and byte-verified in full. The [published additive checkpoint](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/tree/a5f3e138e6d874513f98a355880a9ce0f6fda7da/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T012416Z-ed7313) retains its original cutoff and all 105 verified files. Later results will be appended separately.

Release acceptance remains open: terminal current-source CI/security, full installed platform/performance qualification, update/rollback/signing/canary proof, fresh Greptile 5/5, resolved review threads and genuine independent last-push/CODEOWNER approval. Both prior P2 threads have been addressed on this head and fresh review is requested. Original warm p95/p99 50/100 ms, c16 p99 200 ms, readiness 400 ms, sampling minima and benefit/regression limits remain unchanged. The stopped F campaign and frozen plan remain unchanged. No task promotion, merge, activation or release is claimed.
claim_scope: This preserves the author-reported metadata exactly. It does not independently verify its local or hosted execution claims.
